design.sources: Use the pinned 26 photographed sources from the earlier padding transfer. No detector training or point selection.
design.useful: At least 0.30 intersection over union and 0.50 recall on known edits. Count highlights on untouched and re-encoded sources separately from genuinely changed conventional controls.
